content.text:
Brightloop offers three plans:

- **Free:** €0 for up to 3 users; unlimited projects and 1 GB of storage.
- **Team:** €8 per user/month for up to 50 users; includes timeline view, guest access and 100 GB of storage.
- **Business:** €15 per user/month for unlimited users; includes SSO, an audit log, 1 TB of storage and priority support.

Prices exclude VAT. Annual billing saves 20%, and paid plans come with a 14-day free trial—no card needed. [Pricing details](https://brightloop.example/docs/pricing)
